data.name: Haunted Diary : The Hunting Tower
data.detailed_description:
Haunted Diary is a horror game series told through different episodes. Each game presents a new story, new characters, and a new mystery, all connected by the theme of fear in the unknown.

The first episode, The Hunting Tower, takes place in a remote national park near the border. At first, the days seem uneventful—quiet patrols, routine checks, and paperwork. But strange reports begin to surface: villagers gone missing, the discovery of a dead tiger under suspicious circumstances, and chilling rumors of unnatural sounds echoing through the forest.

As the investigation unfolds, the peaceful landscape starts to feel increasingly threatening. The deeper you go into the woods, the more the silence hides, and the more uncertain each step becomes. The old hunting tower in the northern zone may offer safety—or perhaps conceal darker secrets waiting to be uncovered.

Players will explore, gather evidence, and piece together what is happening inside the park. The focus is on atmosphere, tension, and the mystery of moving forward when nothing feels safe.

Haunted Diary: The Hunting Tower is only the beginning. Future episodes will expand the series, bringing new stories and new horrors to discover.

What begins as a routine patrol soon spirals into a chilling investigation of missing people, strange deaths, and an eerie silence in the forest. Explore, uncover secrets, and survive the unknown.
